## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python -m arena validate <result-file>`.
- [ ] The result uses a versioned workload from `workloads/`.
- [ ] No API key, token, secret, private repository content, or personal data is included.
- [ ] I included the test region, mode, repetitions, and relevant provider configuration.
- [ ] I understand that submissions may be marked pending or rejected if they cannot be reproduced.
